# Local

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Keywords](Language-Features-Keywords)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Local name[type] [= value][, name2[type] ...]
```

## Description

Declares a variable that only exists in the function (or the main program) that declares it, and hides a [Global](Global) of the same name. A variable that is assigned without a declaration is local too, but declaring it makes that clear.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Global x = 1

Function Show()
	Local x = 99
	Print x
End Function

Show()
Print x
```

```text
99
1
```
